title: What Makes Good Data for Training Coding Agents? A Systematic Study on SWE-Gym
abstract: arXiv:2611.30207v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) trains coding agents on software tasks whose hidden tests decide the reward, yet task collections check these tests only against the reference fix. We ask what makes a task good training data, focusing on the correctness of its reward labels. We audit SWE-Gym with two LLM families, and a suspected error counts only if execution reproduces it. We find that unsolved often means mislabelled: 74% of the tasks that a 9B base model never solves have a test that rejects correct fixes (a false negative), versus 20% of those it sometimes solves. We repair or remove such tasks, and the audited tasks that remain train better policies. At equal size and matched difficulty, models trained on them score 2.4 and 2.7 points higher on held-out tasks from SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro than models trained on the original tasks, whereas simply dropping the never-solved tasks shows no such gain. translated_title: 什么才是训练编码智能体的好数据？基于SWE-Gym的系统性研究
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）通过软件任务来训练编码智能体，其奖励由隐藏测试决定，然而现有任务集合仅针对参考修复方案来验证这些测试。我们探究什么使一个任务成为好的训练数据，并重点关注其奖励标签的正确性。我们使用两个大语言模型系列对SWE-Gym进行了审计，且只有当执行能够复现疑似错误时才将其计为错误。我们发现“未被解决”往往意味着“被错误标注”：在一个9B基础模型从未解决的任务中，74%的任务存在会拒绝正确修复方案的测试（即假阴性），而在其偶尔能解决的任务中这一比例仅为20%。我们修复或移除了这类任务，审计后保留的任务能够训练出更好的策略。在相同规模和匹配难度下，用这些任务训练的模型在SWE-bench Verified和SWE-bench Pro的保留任务上分别比用原始任务训练的模型高出2.4分和2.7分，而简单地删除从未被解决的任务则无法带来这样的提升。
tldr: 本研究系统审计了SWE-Gym数据集奖励标签的正确性，发现模型从未解决的任务中74%存在拒绝正确修复的假阴性测试，修复或移除这些错误标注任务后，训练出的模型在SWE-bench Verified和SWE-bench Pro上分别提升2.4分和2.7分。
en_tdlr: This systematic audit of SWE-Gym reveals that 74% of never-solved tasks contain false-negative tests that reject correct fixes, and repairing or removing such mislabeled tasks trains models that score 2.4 and 2.7 points higher on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Pro.
